%load_ext autoreload
%autoreload 2
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import cleaning

sites = pd.read_csv("data/sites.csv")
subjects_raw = pd.read_csv("data/subjects.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("data/visits.csv", parse_dates=["visit_date"])
ref = pd.read_csv("data/ref_ranges.csv")
print(len(sites), "sites,", len(subjects_raw), "subject rows,", len(visits), "visits")

labs_raw = pd.read_csv("data/labs.csv", parse_dates=["collected"])
labs_raw.shape

subjects = (
    subjects_raw.drop_duplicates("subject_id")
    .assign(
        arm=lambda d: cleaning.normalize_arm(d["arm"]),
        sex=lambda d: cleaning.normalize_sex(d["sex"]),
        rand_date=lambda d: pd.to_datetime(d["rand_date"]),
        birth_date=lambda d: pd.to_datetime(d["birth_date"]),
    )
    .merge(sites, on="site_id", how="left")
)
subjects = subjects.assign(age=((subjects.rand_date - subjects.birth_date).dt.days / 365.25).astype(int))
subjects = subjects.assign(age_grp=pd.cut(subjects.age, [17, 40, 65, 120], labels=["18-40", "41-65", ">65"]))
subjects.groupby(["arm", "age_grp"], observed=True).size().unstack()

labs = cleaning.standardize_units(labs_raw)
labs = cleaning.drop_retests(labs)
# @cash:persist
labs = cleaning.flag_range(labs, ref)
print(f"{len(labs_raw) - len(labs):,} re-test rows dropped")
labs.flag.value_counts()

lab_wide = labs.pivot_table(index=["subject_id", "visit"], columns="test_code", values="value_std", aggfunc="mean")
lab_wide.shape

base = (labs.loc[labs.visit == "V1", ["subject_id", "test_code", "value_std"]]
        .rename(columns={"value_std": "base"}))
chg = (labs.merge(base, on=["subject_id", "test_code"], how="left")
       .assign(chg=lambda d: d.value_std - d.base,
               pchg=lambda d: 100 * (d.value_std - d.base) / d.base,
               visit_no=lambda d: d.visit.str[1:].astype(int)))
# @cash:persist
chg = chg.merge(subjects[["subject_id", "arm", "sex", "age", "country"]], on="subject_id", how="inner")
chg.shape
chg[chg.test_code == "GLUC"].groupby("country")["value_std"].median().round(2)

chg_tab = arm_table(chg[chg.visit.isin(["V4", "V7", "V10"])], ["test_code", "visit"], "pchg")
chg_tab

ae_raw = pd.read_csv("data/ae.csv")
ae_raw.shape

ae = ae_raw.assign(
    term=ae_raw.ae_verbatim.map(cleaning.normalize_ae_term),
    grade=cleaning.severity_grade(ae_raw.severity),
    onset_date=pd.to_datetime(ae_raw.onset_date),
)
ae = ae.merge(subjects[["subject_id", "arm", "rand_date"]], on="subject_id", how="inner")
ae = ae.assign(soc=ae.term.map(cleaning.SOC), study_day=(ae.onset_date - ae.rand_date).dt.days + 1)
ae.term.value_counts()
ae.loc[ae.term == "Uncoded", "ae_verbatim"].value_counts()

n_arm = subjects.groupby("arm").size()
ae_tab = (ae.drop_duplicates(["subject_id", "term"])
          .groupby(["term", "arm"]).size().unstack("arm")
          .div(n_arm, axis=1).mul(100).round(1)
          [["Placebo", "Low dose", "High dose"]]
          .sort_values("High dose", ascending=False))
ae_tab

tests = ["GLUC", "LDL", "TRIG", "ALT"]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(tests), figsize=(18, 4), sharey=True)
for ax, test in zip(axes, tests):
    sns.lineplot(data=chg[chg.test_code == test], x="visit_no", y="pchg", hue="arm",
                 errorbar="se", estimator="mean", ax=ax)
    ax.set_title(f"{test}: % change from baseline")
    ax.axhline(0, color="grey", lw=0.8)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

top = ae_tab.head(10).reset_index().melt(id_vars="term", var_name="arm", value_name="pct")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
sns.barplot(data=top, y="term", x="pct", hue="arm", ax=ax)
ax.set_xlabel("% of subjects with at least one event")
plt.show()

def boot_ci(x, n_boot=400, seed=42):
    """Mean and percentile-bootstrap 95% CI of the mean."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    x = x.dropna().to_numpy()
    idx = rng.integers(0, len(x), size=(n_boot, len(x)))
    means = x[idx].mean(axis=1)
    return pd.Series({"mean": x.mean(), "lo": np.percentile(means, 2.5),
                      "hi": np.percentile(means, 97.5), "n": len(x)})

ci = (chg[chg.visit != "V1"].groupby(["test_code", "arm", "visit_no"])["pchg"]
      .apply(boot_ci).unstack())
ci.loc["GLUC"].round(2)

v10 = ci.xs(10, level="visit_no").reset_index()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 8))
for k, (arm, d) in enumerate(v10.groupby("arm")):
    y = np.arange(len(d)) + 0.25 * k
    ax.errorbar(d["mean"], y, xerr=[d["mean"] - d["lo"], d["hi"] - d["mean"]], fmt="o", label=arm, capsize=2)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(d)) + 0.25)
ax.set_yticklabels(d["test_code"])
ax.axvline(0, color="grey", lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("% change from baseline at V10 (95% bootstrap CI)")
ax.legend()
plt.show()

flag_tab = (chg[chg.visit != "V1"].assign(high=lambda d: d.flag == "H")
            .groupby(["test_code", "arm"])["high"].mean().mul(100).unstack("arm")
            [["Placebo", "Low dose", "High dose"]].round(1))
flag_tab

vitals = pd.read_csv("data/vitals.csv")
vit = (vitals.merge(visits, on=["subject_id", "visit"], how="inner")
       .merge(subjects[["subject_id", "arm"]], on="subject_id", how="inner"))
vit_tab = arm_table(vit, "visit", "sbp")
vit_tab

ae_counts = ae.groupby("subject_id").agg(
    n_ae=("term", "size"),
    n_sae=("serious", lambda s: (s == "Y").sum()),
    max_grade=("grade", "max"),
)
last_visit = visits.sort_values("visit_date").groupby("subject_id").tail(1).set_index("subject_id")["visit"]
bl = lab_wide.xs("V1", level="visit").add_prefix("bl_")
adsl = (subjects.merge(ae_counts, on="subject_id", how="left")
        .merge(bl, left_on="subject_id", right_index=True, how="left")
        .assign(last_visit=lambda d: d.subject_id.map(last_visit))
        .fillna({"n_ae": 0, "n_sae": 0, "max_grade": 0}))
adsl.shape

import os
os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
adsl.to_parquet("out/adsl.parquet", index=False)
chg_tab.to_csv("out/lab_change_table.csv")
ae_tab.to_csv("out/ae_table.csv")
flag_tab.to_csv("out/lab_high_flags.csv")
print(sorted(os.listdir("out")))
adsl.groupby(["age_grp", "arm"], observed=True)["n_ae"].mean().unstack().round(2)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
sns.boxplot(data=chg[(chg.test_code == "GLUC") & chg.visit.isin(["V1", "V10"])],
            x="visit", y="value_std", hue="arm", showfliers=False, ax=ax)
ax.set_ylabel("Glucose (mmol/L)")
fig.savefig("out/glucose_box.png", dpi=100)
plt.show()
